# qmd-server
> A lightweight QMD query service that exposes the qmd CLI through a simple HTTP API.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/qmd-server/
GitHub: https://github.com/imba97/qmd-server
Status: documented candidate
Last verified: 2026-11-17
